backfill_note: These records predate provenance recording in src/generate.py. Model, endpoint, plan hash and per-run token usage are as reported by the runs themselves. Wall-clock timestamps were not captured at the time and are not reconstructed here. Later runs write this file directly.
endpoint_region_note: Beijing region; residency discussion in ADR-007.
family_separation: Qwen under test, Kimi generating, DeepSeek blind relabelling and GLM quality judging - four distinct families. The generator, independent relabeller and quality Judge have separate roles (ADR-007).

frozen.note: Asserted by tests/test_freeze.py. Changing the golden set fails the suite until this hash is updated, which forces the explicit commit the freeze rule asks for instead of trusting anyone to remember it.

layout.data/enquiries.jsonl: id, subject, body - what the pipeline reads
layout.data/golden.jsonl: expected labels, tags, reference notes - what the metrics read
layout.note: Two files so the pipeline cannot see the answers: they are not in the file it opens. Joined by id; the loader raises if either side has an id the other lacks.

pseudonymisation_note: Structured identifiers only. Names and places are detected and reported, never rewritten - see src/redaction.py for the measured reason.
